name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength hi)
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi),
    Eq.ndrec (updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu)
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))) ?_⟩
  apply updatedStatesComm
  simp [List.unzip_zip, InitStatesLength hi, UpdateStatesLength hu]
  intro k hk'
  simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  have hp :=
    real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hcomp, hcd, hn, hφ⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hc).mem_nhds hp)
  exact ((hcd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hcomp.mul_right (fun y => (hn (Set.mem_range_self y)).1.eq_or_lt'.elim
      (fun hy => (mul_eq_zero_of_left hy _).ge)
      (fun hy => (mul_pos hy (hs (subset_closure hy.ne'))).le))
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one hφ) hp.ne')).ne' (by
      simpa only [inner_smul_right', Pi.mul_apply] using hg _
        (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hcd, hcomp⟩
          (contDiff_const (c := f x))))

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have h3 := hA.of_le (m := 3) ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j := electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) h3 t
  have hEd (j) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j)
  have hB := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A h3
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x), _root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := i) (v := j) _ (hEs j), div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t x), _root_.smul_apply] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    ext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ =>
      (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB (j, i)) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, one_mul, _root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB (j, i)) t x,
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub,
    mul_assoc, 𝓕.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_left_comm 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ 𝓕.μ₀, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕))
  
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂
    (f := (mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ T).comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c))
    (g := mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ T))
    ?_ a b
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, mulLinearMap_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let x := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      s) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
  let y := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      s))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (h : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      T (ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
          (x * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * y) := by
    simp only [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h]
    simp only [x, y, s, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  simp only [List.append_assoc] at hs
  have h1 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h2 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 h2
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (x * ι c *
          y) := by
      simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, smul_sub]
      rw [h1, h2, ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
        simp at h0
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
          Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, h0, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
          (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
      · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case' app | tapp => cases lc
  all_goals grind (gen := 2) [→ canonical_form_abs, → canonical_form_tabs,
    → canonical_form_sum, → Red.abs, → Red.tabs, → Red.appₗ, → Red.appᵣ, → Red.tapp,
    → Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind, → Red.case, → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr,
    → Red.inl, → Red.inr]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par hA hB iha ihb => apply symm
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.par hA hB | par.red_I =>
    exact I_irreducible _ hA ▸ ⟨_, hB, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par hA hB | par.red_K =>
    rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hA with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hA hB | par.red_S =>
    rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hA with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (hx.par hB).par (hy.par hB), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par _ _ ha hb =>
    rcases iha ha with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
    rcases ihb hb with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, ha₂.par hb₂, ha₁.par hb₁⟩
  case par.refl => exact ⟨_, hA.par hB, .refl _⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro s t (h | h) μ <;>
    apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp <;> intro hf s' ht
  case' choice | choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choiceR | choiceR => use s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)
  all_goals exact (hf _ ht).imp fun _ => And.imp (by
    try exact id
    all_goals exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.sub_sub, ← Nat.sub_sub,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h_i_add_steps)),
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
    rfl
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc
  let Y := fun g : C => fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (Set.ncard ∘ Y) '' Set.univ)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr ⟨0, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := i.castSucc) steps h_i_add_steps
  let e : {x // f x ≠ g.val x} → Y g × Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
    fun x => (⟨q x.val, ⟨x.val, rfl, x.property⟩⟩, k x.val)
  have hr (x : _) :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hb := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective e (by
    intro x z h
    have hq : q x.val = q z.val := congrArg (fun t => t.1.val) h
    have hk : k x.val = k z.val := congrArg Prod.snd h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hr x.val).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z.val)))
  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] at hb
  have hf := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  change 2 * sInf ((Set.ncard ∘ Y) '' Set.univ) ≤ _ at hf
  rw [← hg] at hf
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      ((Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm.le.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hf).trans hid.le))))

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u hp
    refine (funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) :
      finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u) ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) ?_
    rw [← @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F inferInstance ⟨0⟩]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · rw [← @prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun n F inferInstance ⟨0⟩]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at hp
      assumption
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)   := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ :=
    (Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => Set.finite_Icc B T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (f := fun n => fun k : Fin 4 => u (n + k))
      (by
        repeat intro
        apply hb)
  have hs m : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    clear hij
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on
    rename_i m ih
    by_cases hm : 4 ≤ m
    · apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
    · exact congrFun h ⟨m, lt_of_not_ge hm⟩
  use i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hn, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le, hs]

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not] at *
  rw [← Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff Nat.two_pos,
    mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have hr {d e} (h : relation d e) i :
      7 ∣ e i * 10 ^ i.1 - d i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := by
    refine (((hrelation d e).mp h).2 i).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hr h.1 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const,
    Int.nsmul_eq_mul, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  intro i
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, rfl⟩).pow_right
    (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine (dvd_sub (dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)))
    (hr h.1 i)) (hr h.2 i)).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  ring1
